notes.title: Lurch Patch
notes.content:
As we prepare for the upcoming release of Lurch, we’ve been working tirelessly to refine and enhance the game based on internal testing and early feedback. Here’s what’s been updated:
AI Enhancements:Reiterated and Fixed AI Behavior: Our AI system has been thoroughly revised to improve responsiveness and intelligence.Map Improvements:Map Graphics Cleanup: We’ve polished the map visuals to ensure a cleaner and more immersive environment. Enjoy enhanced textures and fewer graphical glitches for a seamless exploration experience right from the start.New Features:Spectating Mode: Added a spectating mode for players to watch the game after they’ve been eliminated.Sprint Mechanic: Introduced a sprint feature.New Task: Added a new task to diversify gameplay and increase challenges.Developer Fixes:Bug Fixes: Addressed various issues identified during testing to enhance game stability and performance.Performance Optimization: Implemented optimizations to reduce lag and improve frame rates, ensuring smooth gameplay even in high-intensity scenes.UI Enhancements: Improved several user interface elements for better navigation and usability.Sound Adjustments: Balanced sound effects and music to provide a more cohesive and immersive audio experience.
We’re excited to bring you these updates and can’t wait for you to experience Lurch. Your feedback will be crucial once the game launches, and we’re committed to delivering the best possible gaming experience.
Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for your support!
Happy gaming!
The Lurch Development Team

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
🎉 Exciting News for future Lurch Players! 🎉

We are thrilled to announce some fantastic updates and improvements to your future favorite game, Lurch! Our team has been hard at work to enhance the gaming experience, and we're excited to roll out these new features:

- Completed skill tree
- Optimized foliage throughout the first map
- General Optimizations such as: Level streaming, varying lods, revised grass maps, optimized 
   materials etc.
- Localizations across the steam store page supporting 13 languages (English, 
- Completed soundtrack 
- AI improved


Potential Upcoming support/features and bug fixes: 

- UI Language support (English, French, Italian, German, Japanese, polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Portugal), Russian, simplified Chinese, Spanish (Latin American), Spanish (Spain)
- Controller support
- Revised task assets
